summary: The app still contains several high‑severity issues that block release. The most critical code problem is the data‑reset photo leak, where receipt image files are not removed when the user invokes "Delete all data", leaving sensitive photos on the device. Two high‑severity third‑party dependency vulnerabilities (braces 3.0.3 and node‑forge 1.4.0) remain in the bundle and must be addressed at deployment time (upgrade or removal). All previously fixed findings remain fixed. No new security issues were introduced by the recent hardening changes, but a number of medium‑severity findings (dependency‑uuid, backup‑restore size DoS, backup passphrase brute‑force, CSV injection, backup‑passphrase length enforcement, sprintf‑js, etc.) are still open and should be mitigated before production.
